verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway is an AI traffic platform, and a buyer could reasonably ask whether it lets users schedule or trigger autonomous background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence covers proxying, routing, A2A/MCP traffic governance, observability and declarative kongctl configuration. None of it documents user-defined automations, scheduled jobs or background agent runs that the product itself executes. Proxying agent traffic and managing config as code are adjacent capabilities, not this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
